## How it works

<h3>Use the plan</h3><p>The opening view shows a dense group of rooms on the first floor. Pan across the floor and zoom to read the other labels. Every first-floor IfcSpace has a label, including circulation and support spaces. The left toolbar’s Topics panel restores the opening plan; Sections shows its floor cut. Select a component and click 1 element selected at the top left for Properties.</p>
<h3>Developer integration</h3><p><code>viewer.IfcAPI</code> queries the storey, spaces, identifiers, names, units, placements and swept footprint profiles from the source IFC. Label positions and footprint areas are calculated from those returned profiles; no room schedule or label coordinates are embedded. Labels fit inside the footprint, and the BCF camera opens a readable view centred on its queried bounds. The clinic model supplies a populated space schedule.</p><p>The page opens the original source bytes with <code>await viewer.IfcAPI</code>, reads native model data, then closes the model and disposes WASM before displaying the source with <code>viewer.add()</code>. See the <a href="https://thatopen.github.io/engine_web-ifc/docs/classes/web-ifc.IfcAPI.html">complete web-ifc API reference</a>.</p>

<h2>Sources and license notices</h2><p>BSI (2020) “Medical-Dental Test Files,” buildingSMART International. Original project provided to the US Construction Engineering Research Laboratory; formerly hosted by the US National Institute of Building Sciences. <a href="https://github.com/buildingsmart-community/Community-Sample-Test-Files/blob/7ddf57a201f88a0c213d5322b02ed15e94a60a40/IFC%202.3.0.1%20(IFC%202x3)/Medical-Dental%20Clinic/Clinic_Architectural.ifc" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Original architectural IFC at the pinned revision</a>. <a href="https://github.com/buildingsmart-community/Community-Sample-Test-Files/blob/7ddf57a201f88a0c213d5322b02ed15e94a60a40/LICENSE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">CC BY 4.0</a>. The model is unchanged. The embedded room labels are derived from its first-floor spaces; areas are calculated from their footprints.</p>
